label: upcoming output of digit 0 (0 output now or within 2 steps; or a leading 0 awaiting recall)
explanation: Anticipates output of the digit 0. When the current output is 0 it fires 95% of the time; activation also ramps up over the 1-3 steps before a 0 is output, e.g. at <DEL> when orig(0)==0. During the original phase it fires on later tokens when the sequence starts with 0 (orig(0) or orig(1) is 0), and gets stronger toward <DEL>. The strongest activations (~1.0 of max) come from sequences with several leading 0s, near and at <DEL>. It is silent at t<2 and nearly silent in sequences with no digits (n_digits=0 holds 2.7% of mass). It does not fire on 0 as an input token as such, only to the extent that 0 is about to be output. Misses: weak activations (bottom quartile, mostly <0.3 of max) 3+ steps ahead of a 0 output and in the original phase after a non-leading 0. Some predicted steps 1-2 before a 0 output are inactive.
